Atención, el 22/06/19 a las 10 hs solicité al muchacho que atiende que me cargara 500 pesos de nafta, cometí el error de darle la tarjeta YPF por los puntos y el dinero, al devolverme la tarjeta negó rotundamente el pago y me cobró nuevamente 👎👎 solicito al dueño verifique e identifique al ladrón que tiene como empleado, supongo debe tener cámaras

(Translated by Google)
Attention, on June 22, 2019, at 10:00 AM, I asked the attendant to fill up my tank with 500 pesos worth of gasoline. I made the mistake of giving him my YPF card for the points and cash. When he returned the card, he flatly refused the payment and charged me again. 👎👎 I request that the owner investigate and identify this thief he employs. I assume there are security cameras.
